dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya's Message
dialogues.text: "I was surprised to find someone hosting a festival tucked away in a little corner of this island, especially a new festival that I'd never heard of. The view here is amazing."

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya's Message
dialogues.text: "Although it's not the liveliest of festivals, it's magical in its own way."

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya's Message
dialogues.text: "Go, go, Arataki Gang! Let me know in advance next time and I'll get you some fireworks, free of charge!"
